description: Queen Mary provides its protected built-in Copilot Chat to all staff through the University's Microsoft 365 subscription.
howToObtain: Open m365.cloud.microsoft/chat and sign in with a Queen Mary IT account; confirm the green shield for the secure QM version.
costToUser: Free to all Queen Mary staff.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: At Queen Mary, the built-in version of Copilot is a free AI assistant available to all Queen Mary staff through our Microsoft 365 subscription. Access it at m365.cloud.microsoft/chat with a Queen Mary IT account; the green shield confirms the secure version and data stays within Queen Mary's Microsoft 365 environment.
